pip_requirements.description: [enable] Renovate's default pip-requirements pattern misses requirements/docs.txt; add that path so Read the Docs requirements are managed

packageRules.description: [automerge] Runtime dependencies and the published dev extra need a review, including the exact pycentral pin. pep621 reports project.dependencies and project.optional-dependencies, not the short names
[automerge,group] Hosted runner image majors (ubuntu-24.04 -> 26.04) change the build environment and are only exercised by the release workflow, so group and review them
[automerge] requirements/docs.txt feeds the Read the Docs build, so its bumps need a review too
